test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. H is sitting at any one of the sides and is exactly opposite to C. G is sitting second to the right of H and second to the left of C. E is sitting exactly opposite to G. B is sitting third to the right of H and is exactly opposite to A. Both G and H are the immediate neighbours of D. Which of the following statements is NOT true with reference to F?

options.text: F is exactly opposite to D
B is sitting to F's second left.
E and C are F's immediate neighbours
H is sitting to F's third left

solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table.

1) H is sitting at any one of the sides and is exactly opposite to C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cffd9212b74975032baf66ffa3c2f2ce9af64c232a8750be9ca8ed7f5414c7f9.png] 

2) G is sitting second to the right of H and second to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dff3ecf8120fda886cf0f3bd95390183b8459017cf1175cad8831658b511734d.png] 

3) E is sitting exactly opposite to G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1e02230af0fc405a6cd96390b4c97d56f82aa93b399db6c5cab53563df1595f.png] 

4) B is sitting third to the right of H and is exactly opposite to A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00077f9da5e46062aaec15a542f445497f8cd3880a13e35f4ceb4209f54b5837.png] 

5) Both G and H are the immediate neighbours of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22f2da1fd7255596c7c6f79665299067bf0af6340f1e8a599fbfb18cdcfddfbc.png] 

6) The empty position around the square table will be occupied by the only person left i.e. F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2f8b7e882616ba514a273c232c06fe5ac2ee3e6b2f706fb959f3ec3932a464d.png] 

Let us check each statement on the basis of seating arrangement:

option 1) F is exactly opposite to D → **True** (It can be clearly seen that F sits exactly opposite to D at the corner)

option 2) B is sitting to F's second left → **True** (It can be seen clearly that B sits to the second left of F at the corner)

option 3) E and C are F's immediate neighbours →** True** (It is clear from the arrangement that F is the immediate neighbour of both E and C)

option 4) H is sitting to F's third left → **False **(It can be seen clearly that H is sitting to F's fifth left and also H is sitting to F's third right)

Hence, **"H is sitting to F's third left" is **NOT true with reference to F**.**
